function: CSI feedback: ACNet compresses the cascaded BS-RIS-user channel matrix into a codeword and reconstructs it at the BS, using LSTM to exploit time correlation across slots (pp. 1-3).
system: RIS-aided FDD massive MIMO downlink: BS with M=32 antennas, passive RIS with N=32 elements (4x8), single-antenna user, direct link blocked; frequency band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: ACNet autoencoder: ConvLSTM encoder, LSTM compression and decompression layers, RefineNet decoder with attention-conv; trained end-to-end with MSE reconstruction loss (unsupervised); 100 epochs, batch 250 (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulated cascaded channel: L1=L2=3 paths with steering vectors, first-order Markov time correlation (alpha=0.1), T=4 slots; 25,000 training and 5,000 test samples; no standard model (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Same simulated setting for training and test; CR 4 to 32 at alpha=0.1; alpha 0.1 to 0.5 at CR=32, with training per alpha not stated (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Learned only: CsiNet and ConvlstmCsiNet [14] (CSI feedback networks); no non-learned feedback method (codebook, compressive sensing) is simulated (pp. 1, 4-5).
metrics: NMSE (dB) and cosine similarity versus compression ratio 4 to 32 (Tables II-III); NMSE versus alpha at CR=32 (Fig. 5); number of parameters (Table I) (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Number of parameters (Table I): ACNet 28.33M (CR=4) to 18.12M (CR=32), ConvlstmCsiNet about the same, CsiNet 2.10M to 0.27M; no FLOPs or runtime (p. 4).
openness: none; no code or data link is given (pp. 1-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "L1 and L2 are the numbers of paths of the BS-RIS channel" - own path model with steering vectors (Eqs. 1-5) and a Markov time-correlation model (Eq. 8); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "Fig. 5 shows the corresponding NMSE of the networks" - a sweep of the time-correlation parameter alpha at CR=32; the paper does not say a trained model is tested on a scenario, array size or dataset unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 4: "we present the simulation results of the CsiNet, the ConvlstmCsiNet, and the ACNet" - only learned networks are compared; the codebook and compressive-sensing methods named on p. 1 are not simulated.
q4_support: p. 4: "We use the number of parameters to express the complexity of the networks." - Table I lists the parameter count of each network per compression ratio.
q5_support: p. 4: "the training set, the test set, and the verification set are 25000, 5000, and 5000" - own generated samples; no code or data link anywhere in pp. 1-5.
notes: Read in full from the PDF text (pp. 1-5) and pages 4 and 5 as images (Tables I to III, Fig. 5). The PDF is the arXiv:2403.12453v1 preprint 'Deep Learning-Based CSI Feedback for RIS-Aided Massive MIMO Systems with Time Correlation' (p. 1); it prints no DOI. Area 2: CSI compression and feedback of the cascaded channel; the RIS phase shifts are not learned. q2: Fig. 5 (p. 5) does not say whether the networks were retrained for each alpha; reviewer to confirm. q3: only learned baselines (CsiNet, ConvlstmCsiNet) are simulated.
